messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: kv-read-error-rate in us-west-2 > 5% on inference/embeddings path. Paging Priya (oncall).
Priya (oncall): Oncall here. Seeing alerts, jumping in. Any customer-facing errors?
Dan (prod-eng): Yes — increased 5xx rate for embedding requests, some timeouts. Dashboard shows spike starting ~2071006700.
Mateo (runtime): Correlated to KV prefix reads. One shard returning a tombstone marker on reads which our runtime currently treats as cache hit->empty value instead of falling back gracefully. This leads to heavy DB reads and downstream timeouts.
Priya (oncall): Can we mitigate by bypassing the prefix/KV cache for affected tenants or routes?
Mateo (runtime): Yes. Two quick mitigations we can do now: 1) flip per-tenant prefix cache bypass flag for noisy tenants, 2) short-circuit prefetch/prefix-write to reduce churn. I'll prepare commands.
Dan (prod-eng): Also suggest a temporary soft quota on embeddings QPS for the noisy tenant to reduce DB pressure.
Priya (oncall): Priorities: minimize 5xx for customers, avoid global perf regressions. Let's do tenant bypass + quota soft-cap + disable prefetch.
Mateo (runtime): Executing admin patch for bypass now. Command:
```
curl -s -XPOST https://admin.internal/api/flags \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"flag":"kv_prefix_bypass","tenants":["acme-corp","beta-inc"],"scope":"runtime","expiry":"2024-11-12T02:00:00Z"}'
```
Mateo (runtime): Pushed flag -> deploy-bot will rollout config to runtime pool.
deploy-bot: rolling out kv_prefix_bypass to runtime-us-west-2 (step: 0 -> 20% -> 100%).
deploy-bot: rollout 20% complete. No template errors.
Priya (oncall): While that rolls, Dan please create a temporary quota rule to cap embedding QPS from the noisy tenant at 60% of baseline. Use soft-limit (429 soft) not hard kill.
Dan (prod-eng): Doing it now. API:
```
POST /internal/quota-rules
{
  "tenant":"acme-corp",
  "route":"/v1/embeddings",
  "qps_limit": 120,
  "mode":"soft",
  "reason":"mitigation - reduce DB pressure while we fix tombstones"
}
```
Dan (prod-eng): Quota rule applied. Telemetry shows inbound QPS for acme-corp dropping ~55% within 45s.
Carla (cs): Notifying CS: Acme impacted users seeing intermittent 5xx, we're applying mitigations (bypass + soft cap). I’ll draft customer note.
Mateo (runtime): Also disabling prefetch for affected shard-group to avoid noisy writes:
```
PATCH /internal/runtime-config
{"prefetch":{"enabled":false,"shard_group":"us-west-2-a"}}
```
deploy-bot: kv_prefix_bypass rollout to 100% complete. Config applied to 48 hosts.
Priya (oncall): Observability — 5xx rate dropped from 5.3% -> 0.8% over 3 minutes. Latency for embeddings back to normal 95p. Good.
Mateo (runtime): Confirmed: bypassed traffic is hitting cold-path DB but at reduced QPS, no cascading timeouts. We'll need a follow-up fix in shard eviction logic to stop tombstones being returned.
Priya (oncall): Escalating for follow-up work: Mateo + Dan + Alice to do a post-incident and root cause. I'm handing this to Alice for long running remediation and customer comms. Handoff notes: bypassed prefix cache for acme-corp/beta-inc, soft quota applied, prefetch disabled, TTL for bypass set to 24h.
Alice (sre): Taking it. I'll open the incident ticket and schedule a 1hr RCA. Also will run a controlled cache flush on the problematic shard if runtime team agrees.
Mateo (runtime): Cache flush command (dry-run first):
```
# dry-run
python tools/kv_admin.py --shard us-west-2-a --list-tombstones --limit 100
# flush
python tools/kv_admin.py --shard us-west-2-a --flush-tombstones --confirm
```
Priya (oncall): Customer impact summary for internal postmortem: ~2 major customers saw up to 10% of requests 5xx for ~8 minutes until mitigations stabilized. No data loss.
Carla (cs): Sending proactive helpdesk note to acme-corp and opening a priority support ticket.
Alice (sre): I'll own follow-ups: fix rollout plan for proper tombstone handling, add an automated detector for tombstone-return-rates, and a runbook step to flip bypass and quotas in <5m.
Priya (oncall): Thanks team. Marking as mitigated. Oncall clear but Alice will continue post-incident work.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring.
Priya (oncall): Handoff complete to Alice. If anything regresses ping me. :thumbsup:
